IGUI_CQ_AssignD_board: Listed on the player board, anyone can take it any time - good for weekday free play
IGUI_CQ_AssignD_everyone: The first reader who accepts starts it for everyone (during an event: every participant)
IGUI_CQ_AssignD_reader: Whoever reads the sheet and accepts gets their own copy
IGUI_CQ_AssignD_role: For events: give it to a role and it is assigned when the event starts
IGUI_CQ_BuffNote: Overlapping buffs use the highest multiplier. Penalized players get buff x penalty. All times are real time in the zone set on Settings.
IGUI_CQ_CompleteTip: Skip the remaining steps and give rewards now
IGUI_CQ_ConsumeTip: On = counted items are removed so they cannot be reused
IGUI_CQ_Ctx_ToSidebar: Put the icon back in the sidebar
IGUI_CQ_DashNoEvent: No open or live event - create one on the Events page
IGUI_CQ_EFlow: Flow: Save -> Open sign-up (players see it and join) -> at start time: roles + kits + missions -> at end time: it ends and penalties are applied
IGUI_CQ_Err_active: This mission is already open for everyone
IGUI_CQ_Err_noleave: Too late to leave - the event started or you got the kit
IGUI_CQ_EventHint: Pick an event on the left or create one
IGUI_CQ_FromHandTip: Hold the item in your main hand and click
IGUI_CQ_FromRadioTip: Turn on a radio or walkie, tune it, then click
IGUI_CQ_GiveKitsTip: Give kits to anyone who has not received theirs
IGUI_CQ_GiveMeTip: Give this mission to yourself to try it
IGUI_CQ_GotPen: You got a penalty from this event
IGUI_CQ_HideZoneTip: Players get no arrow/pin, only the hints
IGUI_CQ_IconTip:
Cookie Quest
Events - Missions - EXP buffs
IGUI_CQ_KillZone: Kills must be inside an area
IGUI_CQ_KitSoon: Your kit goes straight to your inventory when the event starts
IGUI_CQ_MakeSheetTip: The sheet goes to your inventory - place it anywhere for players to find
IGUI_CQ_MapPick: Cookie Quest: set the spot here (%1, %2)
IGUI_CQ_MaxTip: Maximum players in this role (0 = unlimited)
IGUI_CQ_MissionHint: Pick a mission on the left or create one
IGUI_CQ_NavMissing: The Navigator mod is not installed
IGUI_CQ_NavNoRoute: Navigator found no route - sit in a car with a Navigator radio
IGUI_CQ_NavTip: Send the destination to the Navigator car GPS mod
IGUI_CQ_NoEvents:
No events right now
Watch the Discord announcements
IGUI_CQ_NoMissionLib: No missions yet - create one on the Missions page
IGUI_CQ_NoMissions:
No missions yet
Find a mission sheet or take one from the board
IGUI_CQ_NotTuned: You have no radio turned on
IGUI_CQ_OpenRegTip: Players can see and join; it starts automatically on time
IGUI_CQ_Opt_KeyTip: Opens/closes the Cookie Quest window (works without the icon)
IGUI_CQ_PenExplain: When the event ends, anyone who joined (got the kit) but passed fewer than %1 checkpoint(s) gets an EXP %2 debuff for %3 days. On an x2 day they get x2 times %2.
IGUI_CQ_PenRule: Rule: pass at least %1 checkpoint(s) or get an EXP %2 debuff for %3 real days
IGUI_CQ_PenUndo: Undo all penalties of this event
IGUI_CQ_PhAdminNote: Admins can always press Open next phase on the Overview page
IGUI_CQ_PhAll: Every mission of this phase is finished (all roles)
IGUI_CQ_PhAllTip: Opens the next phase for everyone once no mission of this phase is left
IGUI_CQ_PhEmpty: No missions in this phase yet
IGUI_CQ_PhHint:
Split the event into phases 1 > 2 > 3 so each role gets missions at the right moment. Players cannot see missions of phases that are not open yet.
Pick each mission's phase in the Roles and Kits & missions tabs (the < Phase > control next to ticked missions).
IGUI_CQ_PhKeyTip: When this mission is done, the next phase opens for everyone
IGUI_CQ_PhLast: Last phase: runs until the event ends
IGUI_CQ_PhModeD_parallel: When a phase opens everyone gets its missions at once; unfinished earlier missions stay playable.
IGUI_CQ_PhModeD_strict: A player/team gets the next phase once it is open and they finished their missions of the current phase.
IGUI_CQ_PhPickTip: Phase that hands out this mission
IGUI_CQ_PhPlan: The whole plan: who does what in each phase
IGUI_CQ_PhSelf: Whoever finishes this phase moves on (solo/team)
IGUI_CQ_PhSelfTip: No waiting: a player or team that finished its own missions of this phase gets the next phase right away
IGUI_CQ_PhTimerTip: Counted from the moment this phase opened (real time)
IGUI_CQ_PhWhen: Go to phase %1 when (first one wins)
IGUI_CQ_PlNoZone: No spot set! It can never pass
IGUI_CQ_RadioHint: Create a hint channel. Players with a radio, walkie or car radio on that frequency see the lines above their head, looping.
IGUI_CQ_RescueArmed: Target is inside - get them out!
IGUI_CQ_RescueWait: Waiting for the target to be inside
IGUI_CQ_RewardWhoContrib: Team mission: only players who helped pass at least one step get the reward
IGUI_CQ_RewardWhoMembers: Team mission: everyone who has it gets the reward
IGUI_CQ_RewardWhoSolo: Solo mission: the player gets the reward
IGUI_CQ_RoleLater: Your role is assigned when the event starts
IGUI_CQ_RoleMode_admin: Admins assign roles (the rest are random at start)
IGUI_CQ_RoleMode_none: No roles, everyone gets the same kit
IGUI_CQ_RoleMode_pick: Pick your role when you join
IGUI_CQ_RoleMode_random: Roles are assigned randomly when the event starts
IGUI_CQ_RolesOff: Roles are set to None (General tab) - these roles are not used yet
IGUI_CQ_RouteHidden: This mission has %1 steps (revealed one by one)
IGUI_CQ_S_EvD:
Four spirit seals are back in survivor hands... Lord Crumble knows. He fled with the last one.
Tonight everyone gets a role. Do your part, then gather at the altar to end the greedy ghost.
Careful... one of us works for the Lord.
IGUI_CQ_S_M1a: Place 30 vials of blood on the altar
IGUI_CQ_S_M1s:
The cookie crumbs Lord Crumble ate flow in the blood of the dead.
Bring 30 vials to the altar and he will have to come out...
IGUI_CQ_S_M2s:
The soldiers who once guarded Knox Country now guard Lord Crumble.
Clear them out.
IGUI_CQ_S_M3s: That door opens for no one. Only one key gets through.
IGUI_CQ_S_M4a: Place the doll at the ritual spot
IGUI_CQ_S_M4s:
Do not put the doll down. Do not look back if something calls you.
Bring it to the ritual spot.
IGUI_CQ_S_M5s:
Burn this after reading. Nobody knows you are mine.
Lure zombies, make noise, lead them astray...
IGUI_CQ_S_M6s:
Lord Crumble is here, with friends.
Hold the altar until the ritual ends.
IGUI_CQ_S_R1d: Collect 30 blood samples and place them on the altar
IGUI_CQ_S_R2d: Clear the horde guarding the way, then escort everyone to the altar
IGUI_CQ_S_R3d: You hold the key to the sealed door. Reach it.
IGUI_CQ_S_R4d: Carry the holy doll to the ritual spot. Do not lose it.
IGUI_CQ_S_R5d:
Stir them up. If more than 2 of them fall, I will reward you.
- Lord Crumble
IGUI_CQ_SampleTip: Creates a draft event + 6 missions + 5 roles of the Lord Crumble finale. All spots are where you stand - move them. Bandages stand in for blood vials.
IGUI_CQ_SchedHint: Pick a schedule on the left or add one (e.g. every Saturday 18:00-23:00 x2)
IGUI_CQ_SecretTip: Others cannot see who has this role
IGUI_CQ_ShowRouteTip: Dot-dash line on the ground to the checkpoint, along streets and sidewalks, around walls and water
IGUI_CQ_ShowStepsTip: Off = revealed one step at a time
IGUI_CQ_SkillPick: Buffed skills (%1/5 picked, none = all skills)
IGUI_CQ_SpHint:
Zombie spawn points for this event: random zombies keep appearing inside the area while the event is live, and stop when a chosen checkpoint is passed, enough of them died, an admin turns them off, or the event ends.
Zombies only appear while a player is close enough for the area to be loaded.
IGUI_CQ_SpKillsTip: Only zombies spawned by this point count
IGUI_CQ_SpMaxAliveTip: At the cap spawning pauses until some die (keeps the server light)
IGUI_CQ_SpNote: Admins can stop it any time: Stop this point (above, while live) or Stop all spawn points on the Overview page. Stopped points disappear; zombies already spawned stay.
IGUI_CQ_SpStepTip: Stops as soon as anyone in this event passes this step of this mission
IGUI_CQ_SpStopWhen: Stop when (first one wins - the event end also stops it)
IGUI_CQ_StepD_admin: Passes when an admin clicks Pass on the Overview page
IGUI_CQ_StepD_deliver: Passes when enough items lie in the area (floor/containers/bags)
IGUI_CQ_StepD_hold: Passes after enough time spent inside (counts while occupied)
IGUI_CQ_StepD_kill: Passes after enough zombie kills, optionally inside an area
IGUI_CQ_StepD_others: Passes when enough other event players die (for spies)
IGUI_CQ_StepD_radio: Passes when a radio is tuned to this frequency
IGUI_CQ_StepD_reach: Passes when someone walks into the area
IGUI_CQ_StepD_rescue: Passes when the target player was inside the area and gets brought out
IGUI_CQ_T_sheet: Created sheet "%1" x%2 - check your inventory
IGUI_CQ_TeamInfo: Team of %1 - you helped pass %2 step(s)
IGUI_CQ_TeamTip: On = everyone who has it works on one shared progress
IGUI_CQ_TrackerTip: Click = open Cookie Quest, drag = move
IGUI_CQ_WrongFloor: On the spot but wrong floor: go to %1
IGUI_CQ_XpNone: Nothing yet - start a buff, do something that gives EXP (chop wood, run) and come back
IGUI_CQ_XpTest: Self-check: last EXP bonuses you (admin) received
